jobs.description: Employer: New York City Fire Pension Fund Expires: 09/26/2026 The NYC Fire Pension Fund is looking for an Entry-Level Pension Portal Support Engineer.Job DescriptionWe are seeking a detail-oriented, customer-focused, and tech-savvy Entry-Level Pension Portal Support Engineer to join our growing team. In this role, you will act as the first line of technical and functional support for our internal users and external plan participants navigating our digital pension management portal. This is an excellent opportunity for an aspiring technologist looking to build a career at the intersection of fintech, enterprise software, and financial services. Troubleshooting & Diagnostics: Investigate, diagnose, and resolve user-reported software glitches, authentication/login errors, browser compatibility problems, and document upload failures. Account & Data Management: Handle secure user credential resets, multi-factor authentication (MFA) issues, role-based access adjustments, and basic participant profile updates in compliance with data privacy standards. Ticket Lifecycle Management: Accurately log, track, prioritize, and manage support cases using tools like [e.g., Jira, ServiceNow, Zendesk], ensuring Service Level Agreements (SLAs) are met. Escalation & Collaboration: Partner with tier-2/3 software engineers, QA teams, and pension administrators to escalate complex bugs, system outages, or data discrepancy issues. Documentation: Create and maintain user-facing knowledge base articles, FAQs, and internal troubleshooting guides to streamline future support resolutions. Qualifications & SkillsEducation: Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Management Information Systems (MIS), Finance, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience). Technical Aptitude:Basic understanding of web applications, cloud-based portals, and relational databases (SQL familiarity is a plus).Familiarity with web browsers, developer tools (console error checking), and operating systems (Windows/macOS).Experience with help desk ticketing platforms (e.g., Zendesk, ServiceNow, Jira Service Desk). Soft Skills:Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical pension plan members patiently. Strong empathy, patience, and customer-first mindset.High attention to detail, particularly regarding data security and confidentiality. Preferred (Not Required):Prior internship or customer/technical support experience in fintech, HR tech, insurance, or financial/pension administration. Basic knowledge of retirement plans (Defined Benefit / Defined Contribution) or financial compliance regulations (e.g., ERISA, GDPR).

completion.Examples of Internship ProjectsDepending on current company priorities and the student's skills, an intern could be asked to:Build a dashboard that combines operational and financial information for management.Automate a manual Excel or reporting process.Develop or enhance an internal web application used by VGI employees.Create an API integration between two business systems.Analyze business data using SQL, Excel, Power BI, or Python and present the findings.Help develop an AI-enabled feature for an existing VGI application.Test a new customer-facing application and document defects and recommended improvements.Create a workflow that eliminates repetitive data entry.Assist with reporting from CRM, ERP, marketing, project-management, or other business work and explaining its business value.Financial Literacy and Business RelevanceAlthough this is primarily a technology and digital-operations internship, students will gain exposure to the financial implications of technology decisions.Projects may require interns to work with financial and operational data, analyze costs, evaluate process efficiency, measure the impact of automation, develop management reports, and understand how technology investments contribute to organizational performance.This provides an opportunity for students to connect technical skills with fundamental business concepts such as revenue, expense, profitability, productivity, return on investment, resource allocation, budgeting, and data-driven decision-making.Desired Academic BackgroundThe internship is appropriate for students pursuing a bachelor's degree in areas such as:Computer ScienceComputer Information SystemsManagement Information SystemsData AnalyticsCybersecurityBusiness AnalyticsFinance or Accounting with strong technology/data skillsOther related technology or business disciplinesA completed degree is not required for internship candidates.Desired Technical SkillsCandidates should have coursework, experience, or a strong interest in several of the following:PythonSQLJavaScript or comparable programming languagesMicrosoft ExcelPower BI or other business-intelligence toolsDatabasesREST APIs and system integrationsWeb application developmentArtificial intelligence and generative AISource controlApplication testingTechnical documentationExperience with technologies such as React, Node.js, .NET, cloud platforms, Docker, GitHub, and CI/CD is beneficial but not required for every internship assignment.Professional SkillsSuccessful interns should demonstrate:Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.Curiosity and willingness to learn new technologies.Good written and verbal communication.Organization and attention to detail.Ability to manage assigned priorities and follow through on commitments.Ability to work independently when appropriate while seeking guidance when needed.Ability to collaborate with technical and nontechnical employees.Professional handling of company and customer information.Supervision and Responsible Technology UseInterns will work under the direction of VGI Technology leadership and designated project stakeholders.Interns may participate in the development and testing of real business solutions; however, material production changes, external product releases, access to sensitive information, and jobs.title: Sales Development Representative at Inner Peak
jobs.description: Employer: Inner Peak Expires: 09/27/2026 This position is ideal for a recent college graduate looking for their first sales role or a college student looking to earn a little extra money and gain valuable experience. We are a lean team trying to keep costs low. This role is compensated solely based on results - you will be paid per meeting you book for our CEO, as well as a percentage of any deal that closes. There is no base salary, and we have no flexibility on this. If you are not comfortable working on commission only, please do not apply. Summary: Inner Peak AI (www.innerpeak.ai) is blending new AI technology with human therapist expertise to deliver truly personalized, affordable mental wellness support 24/7. We are starting by serving high school and college students but eventually intend to be everyone’s mental wellness safety net, triaging users and delivering them to video content, human therapists, or crisis resources. We are a mission-driven company created out of our founders; own lived experience and struggles with mental health, and are still a small (but motivated) team. Peak’s founders met in undergrad at Harvard a decade ago before reconnecting recently over their shared interest in technology and mental health. We have built and launched a mobile application that has two thousand users and is live at several high schools. Initial student usage data is strong, giving us powerful case studies. To raise our next round of fundraising, we must scale this to more schools. We are looking for hungry interns who care about making a difference in peer mental health and who want high-upside potential through our performance-based compensation. This role is great training for anyone interested in going into sales, as you will report to a sales manager with 10+ years of sales experience. If you are successful at this role, over time it could turn into a full account executive role with a base salary. Responsibilities:You will be acting as a lead-generation sales representative for Inner Peak, talking to real potential customersYou will be calling private and charter school principals, deans of students, directors of counseling, and counselorsYou will learn to use Hubspot, the top startup CRMYour primary goal is to generate interest in Inner Peak’s solution so school leaders will want to see a demo of Inner PeakYour success will be measured in number of meetings booked for our CEO Qualifications:Preference for past sales experience - at minimum you must WANT to sellNo requirement for past sales experience (though it could help), but you have to WANT to sellYou must be personable, friendly, and not intimidated by cold callingInterest in / passion for mental health and / or K-12 educationHard-working, with the ability to put your head down and do callsA self-starter looking to bet on yourself You must be able to devote at least 10 hours a week during normal business hours to the role (though preference for candidates who can devote more)

jobs.description: Employer: Change.org Expires: 09/27/2026 Change.vote Campus AmbassadorAbout the roleWe're looking for a Campus Ambassador to help students on campus learn who is on their November ballot. Change.org runs Change.vote, a ballot guide that shows voters the candidates on their ballot, along with their policy positions and endorsements. Your job is to make sure students on your campus know it exists and use it before Election Day, November 3, 2026.You'll reach students through the channels that already work on your campus, including but not limited to clubs, campus-wide communications, tabling, relational organizing (talking to your own networks); whatever gets results where you are. Cost coverage for printed materials or tabling fees associated with outreach.

jobs.title: Engineering Intern (Spring 2027) at SRC, Inc
jobs.description: Employer: SRC, Inc Expires: 09/27/2026 SRC Inc. is seeking Engineering Interns for spring 2027 who will be working onsite, 40 hours a week. As an engineering intern, you will contribute to the design, development, implementation and testing of state-of-the-art radar and electronic warfare products. Based on your interests, you will be selected to work in one specialization from Embedded Design, Machine Intelligence, Integration & Test Engineering, or Software Engineering. You will work closely with senior engineers and gain experience in creating innovative solutions tailored to our products and customer needs. You will bring your unique perspective to our multi-department teams of engineers and collaborate on designs aligned with project goals and requirements. What You'll Do Embedded Design: * Design, develop, implement, test and optimize firmware using VHDL/Verilog * Work with FPGAs and System-on-Chips (SoCs) to develop electronic warfare and radar systems * Learn and apply FPGA design principles including RTL design, verification, logic synthesis, prototyping, and timing analysis * Use Python, TCL and other scripting languages to automate continuous development, continuous integration (CI/CD) workflows Software Engineer: * Design and develop high-quality software solutions using an Agile workflow * Write clean, efficient code and participate in code reviews to ensure delivery of quality products * Communicate proposed software solutions with multi-department engineering teams. * Develop sound software engineering principles using tools such as Git, Bamboo, Sonarqube * Adapt to new technologies and languages including Docker, Kubernetes, Rust as program needs allow Machine Intelligence Engineer: * Develop machine learning algorithms and models to enhance product capabilities * Analyze data to identify patterns and optimize decision-making processes * Work with software and hardware teams to integrate AI/ML solutions into products Integration & Test Engineer: * Participate in design requirements reviews to ensure the requirements can be tested * Coordinate integration of subsystems and components into full systems. * Develop, execute and troubleshoot test plans and procedures to validate system functionality. * Increase testing efficiency by utilizing Python-based automated test suite. * Utilize model-based tools to define test strategies and verifications against system designs What You'll Bring * Completion of two years of college and current enrollment in a bachelor's degree in a relevant engineering field (e.g., Electrical, Computer, Computer Science, or Software) * A minimum grade point average of 3.3. Most recent transcripts are required with application (unofficial transcripts are acceptable) * A strong understanding of your engineering fields foundational concepts * Knowledge of design, testing, and debugging techniques relevant to your field * Ability to take initiative and proactively address challenges * Familiarity with applicable tools and methodologies * Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment with excellent communication skills What Sets Us Apart?SRC, Inc., a not-for-profit research and development company, combines information, science, technology and ingenuity to solve "impossible" problems in the areas of defense, environment and intelligence. Across our family of companies, we apply bright minds, fresh thinking and relentless determination to deliver innovative products and services that areredefining possible®. When you join our team, you'll be a part of something truly meaningful - helping to keep America and its allies safe and strong. You'll collaborate with more than 1,400 engineers, scientists and professionals - with 20 percent of those employees having served in the military - in a highly innovative, inclusive and equitable work environment. You'll receive a competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package that includes four or more weeks of paid time off to start, 10 percent employer contribution toward retirement, and 100 percent tuition support. Total compensation for this role is market competitive. The anticipated range for this position based out of Syracuse, NY is estimated at $22.00 to $26.00/hour. The actual salary will vary based on applicant's experience, skills, and abilities, geographic location as well as other business and organizational needs. SRC offers competitive benefit options, for more details please visit our website. Non-Discrimination Statement Individuals seeking employment are considered without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or age, or status as a protected veteran or disability except as strictly required by applicable law. You are being given the opportunity to provide the following information in order to help us comply with federal and state record keeping, reporting, and other legal requirements, including requirements under Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act, 29 U.S.C. 793, and the Vietnam Era Veterans' Readjustment Assistance Act (VEVRAA), 38 U.S.C. 4212.Learn more about SRC: About UsEmployee BenefitsAwards & RecognitionSecurity Clearance * Location Syracuse, New York

Communication – Excellent communication and presentation skills; demonstrate an ability to effectively communicate and present results that articulate key themes and messages. Organization – Must be able to allocate time effectively and work under pressure to meet tight deadlines, handle multiple demands and competing priorities, and adapt to new ideas and change. Comfortable following direction but also contributing to the direction. Software – Must have advanced knowledge of Excel, PowerPoint and Word; knowledge of Argus or Yardi an asset. Familiarity with AI-enabled tools to support research, analysis, or productivity is considered an asset. Relationship – Must be extremely proactive and work well in a collaborative environment, with the ability to take guidance but then move projects forward independently. Values – Embrace and pro-actively support QuadReal’s values and its culture of environmental sustainability and corporate and social responsibility. Experience – Previous experience in real estate investment, asset management, development, construction oversight, architecture, or engineering. Understanding of real estate fundamentals and project finance along with investment and asset management practices and the full cycle of project planning, design, and execution. The expected hourly rate for this role is $36. Its assets under management are $98.5 billion. From its foundation in Canada as a full-service real estate operating company, QuadReal has expanded its capabilities globally for investments in equity and debt in both the public and private markets. QuadReal invests directly through operating platforms in which it holds an ownership interest and via programmatic partnerships. QuadReal seeks to deliver strong investment returns while creating sustainable environments that bring value to the people and communities it serves. Now and for generations to come. We are actively looking for a Summer Analyst, U.S. Real Estate Debt to join the team in Summer 2027. This role is based in New York City and will report directly to the Associate, U.S. Debt Investments. The Summer Analyst will assist with the analysis and underwriting of new investment opportunities, conducting due diligence, and monitoring existing portfolio investments. The Summer Analyst plays an important role supporting the execution of the growth strategy for QuadReal’s U.S. debt platform. What We Offer: An organization and leaders that support your development through meaningful work experience A Student Mentorship Program designed to provide support throughout your experience Opportunities to build your industry knowledge through weekly Speaker Series & Fireside Chats Opportunities to participate in case competitions within QuadReal during your work term, fostering cross-functional collaboration with intern peers and enhancing exposure to real-world problem-solving. Giving back to the community with your peers and team members through volunteering events Opportunities to build long-lasting industry and professional relationships What You Will Experience: Assist in the analysis, underwriting, structuring, and preparation of investment memorandums for investment opportunities including new investments, extensions, and amendments. Conduct thorough due diligence of investment documents, third-party reports, and market data to support new loan origination. Conduct market research leveraging external databases, discussions with market participants, and internal research tools to support investment opportunities across multiple markets and asset classes. Create and maintain detailed cashflow and valuation models for new investment opportunities. Support the Investment Team in the monitoring of existing investments. Actively adhere to compliance and risk management policies. What You Will Bring: Education – Completing university degree with major in Real Estate, Finance, Mathematics/Statistics, Computer Science or Economics. Analytical – Strong quantitative and analytical skills; detail-oriented and proficient in building and handling complicated data sets. Communication – Excellent communication and presentation skills; demonstrate an ability to effectively communicate and present results that articulate key themes and messages. Organization – Must be able to allocate time effectively and work under pressure to meet tight deadlines, handle multiple demands and competing priorities, and adapt to new ideas and change. Comfortable following direction but also contributing to the direction. Software – Must have advanced knowledge of Excel, PowerPoint and Word; knowledge of Argus Enterprise a plus. Familiarity with AI-enabled tools to support research, analysis, or productivity is considered an asset. Relationship – Must be extremely proactive and work well in a collaborative environment, with the ability to take guidance but then move projects forward independently. Values – Embrace and pro-actively support QuadReal’s values and its culture of environmental sustainability and corporate and social responsibility. Experience – Previous experience working with a real estate company (asset manager or developer), real estate brokerage or advisory firm, appraisal firm, or real estate lender is desirable. A strong interest in developing a career within real estate is essential. The expected hourly rate for this role is $36. About QuadReal Property Group QuadReal Property Group is a global real estate investment, development and operating company headquartered in Vancouver, British Columbia. Its assets under management are $98.5 billion. From its foundation in Canada as a full-service real estate operating company, QuadReal has expanded its capabilities globally for investments in equity and debt in both the public and private markets. QuadReal invests directly through operating platforms in which it holds an ownership interest and via programmatic partnerships. QuadReal seeks to deliver strong investment returns while creating sustainable environments that bring value to the people and communities it serves. Now and for generations to come. Applicants may also be considered for alternative positions within the organization where their qualifications and experience align more closely with available opportunities. jobs.feedName: David Nazarian College of Business & Economics
jobs.title: Business Analyst Intern at Right Click
jobs.description: Employer: Right Click Expires: 09/27/2026 Consulting is finally reaching small and medium businesses.Strategy consulting has long had a price floor. A partner sold the work, and a pyramid of analysts did the research, the document review, the benchmarking, the models, the first drafts. That pyramid is roughly why serious advisory work tended to start around $100,000, which left the small and mid-sized businesses that make up most of the economy largely outside the market.That's starting to change. Analytical work that would have taken weeks can now often be done by a agile team with a good AI workflow. It starts to look possible to deliver real advisory work to a 60-person manufacturer in Orange County at a price they'd actually pay.We're a managed IT and cybersecurity firm working with clients across aerospace, defense, healthcare, and professional services in Southern California. We already have the relationships, and we have an unusual amount of data — years of ticket history, systems inventory, security posture, and software spend for every client we serve. It's close to the raw material an outside consultant would spend weeks trying to assemble. We're building a consulting practice that turns that operational data into recommendations clients can act on.What you'd actually doYou'd take a live client, pull their operational data, and look for the story in it — where money is leaking, which systems have quietly become shelfware, what's generating the same ticket forty times a month, where they might be exposed on compliance. Then you'd build the analysis and write up the recommendation.The intent is that your work, with your name on it, shapes what we end up advising a client to do, rather than arriving as a research task with the interesting part already decided.What you leave withA portfolio of real client work, which not many interns get. Real fluency in AI-assisted analysis — a competence a lot of firms are hiring for and most programs haven't caught up to yet. And some sense of what it looks like to build a business model from the inside, which is a different education than a semester of cases about someone else's.We're looking forA business, finance, economics, or analytics student who's curious about how companies actually run, reasonably comfortable with messy data and Excel, and a clear writer. It helps if you've already been using Claude or similar AI tools on your own coursework and have some feel for where they're genuinely useful and where they aren't. More than any of that, we're looking for someone who wants to go find the answer rather than wait to be handed the question.ApplySend a résumé and a short note — three or four sentences on a business problem you've found interesting lately — to [careers@rclick.com].Right Click is an equal opportunity employer.Benefits:401(k)401(k) matchingDental insuranceEmployee assistance programFlexible spending accountHealth insurancePaid time offProfessional development assistanceRetirement planVision insuranceWork Location: In person

jobs.title: Risk Advisory Intern - Summer 2027 - Los Angeles at Grant Thornton
jobs.description: Employer: Grant Thornton Expires: 09/27/2026 Please apply to the position/location you are most interested in. In order to be considered for this position you must: 1. Apply through the Grant Thornton Job portal at www.grantthornton.com/campuscareers (including resume and transcript) Who is Grant Thornton? At Grant Thornton, we believe in making business more personal and building trust into every result – for our clients and you. Here, we go beyond your expectations of a career in professional services by offering a career path with more: more opportunity, more flexibility, and more support. It’s what makes us different, and we think being different makes us better. In the U.S., Grant Thornton delivers professional services through two specialized entities: Grant Thornton LLP, a licensed, certified public accounting (CPA) firm that provides audit and assurance services ― and Grant Thornton Advisors LLC (not a licensed CPA firm), which exclusively provides non-attest offerings, including tax and advisory services. In 2025, Grant Thornton formed a multinational, multidisciplinary platform with Grant Thornton Ireland. The platform offers a premier Trans-Atlantic advisory and tax practice, as well as independent American and Irish audit practices. With $2.7 billion in revenues and more than 50 offices spanning the U.S., Ireland and other territories, the platform delivers a singular client experience that includes enhanced solutions and capabilities, backed by powerful technologies and a roster of 12,000 quality-driven professionals enjoying exceptional career-growth opportunities and a distinctive cross-border culture. Grant Thornton is part of the Grant Thornton International Limited network, which provides access to its member firms in more than 150 global markets. About Advisory Services Grant Thornton’s Advisory professionals are progressive thinkers who create, protect, and transform value today, so our clients have the opportunity to thrive and grow. Our advisory practice creates holistic solutions delivered by innovative, curious professionals who bring technical depth and industry insight to our clients. What is Risk Advisory? Within our Cyber & Risk Solution Family, Risk Advisory helps organizations grow with confidence by delivering agile, technology-enabled risk services that strengthen resilience, improve business performance, and unlock new opportunities. We work with complex organizations to assess, transform, and operate internal controls, risk management, compliance and Internal Audit activities, programs, and functions. POSITION SUMMARY: Risk Advisory Interns are responsible for working on client engagements, including: Assessing business and information technology processes and system internal controls. Executing enterprise, operational, information technology and third-party risk management and compliance programs. Executing internal audit plans, including information technology internal audits. ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES: Understand, document, and assess various client operations, processes, systems, controls, and programs, and identify opportunities for improvement Assist with conducting risk assessments to inform enterprise risk, operational risk and third-party risk management projects, programs and internal audit plans. Assess transactions, processes, systems, and controls to support assessments, Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) and other regulatory compliance, and internal audit projects. Obtain and analyze data, identify trends, and visualize results using commercially available analytics solutions. Leverage analytics, automation, artificial intelligence (AI), and other technology aids to advance your understanding, drive throughput on project objectives, and deliver client services efficiently and effectively. Establish and maintain good working relationships with team members and clients, and work effectively with client personnel at all levels. Collaborate closely with team members and clients to understand project approach, identify and manage project risks, execute assigned project responsibilities, and recommend opportunities to improve processes, internal controls, risk management, and compliance. Obtain an understanding of relevant industry trends, business objectives, operations, processes, systems, etc. applicable to assigned client projects Assist with business development activities including conducting research, contributing to proposals, and other activities as appropriate. Participate in Firm activities such as recruiting, training, officewide activities, and more. Other duties as assigned. Why become a Risk Advisory Intern? A Risk Advisory Intern will gain exposure to various industries, business processes, operations, systems and controls as an integral member of project delivery teams. As a Risk Advisory Intern, you will be executing high quality Risk Advisory projects and services under the supervision of experienced Risk Advisory team members. You will be responsible for efficiently managing your workload to budget and timeline. What are we looking for in an Intern? We are seeking self-starters and analytical thinkers who are curious, enjoy working in a collaborative, performance-driven environment, and want to help our clients solve complex problems using the latest technology and data-enabled methods. Risk Advisory Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Information Technology, MIS or related field. Desire to pursue CPA, PMP, CISA, CIA, CISSP, CAMS, CISM, or other relevant license/certification preferred. Overall GPA of 3.0/4.0. Available to travel at least 25% as required. Ability to work additional hours as needed. Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for employment-based visa sponsorship now or in the future. No visa sponsorship is available for this position. Skill Requirements Ability to learn, understand and work across various industries and functional areas within an organization. Excellent analytical, communication (written and verbal), presentation, and interpersonal skills. Strong technical aptitude, complex analysis, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills. Effective project and time management skills. Ability to work in a rapidly growing, fast-paced, interactive, performance-driven team environment. Enthusiasm to learn through a combination of structured, on-the-job and self-directed training. Ability to work efficiently and effectively independently and in a team environment. Desire to pursue applicable professional license/certification as outlined above. TRAINING: Grant Thornton LLP provides both local and national training programs related to an individual’s job responsibilities. We are committed to ongoing professional development, and we encourage individuals to attend outside training seminars. A strong sense of ownership over one’s own training and development is key to success in this role. The team you’re about to join is ready to help you thrive. Here’s how: Whether it’s your work location, weekly schedule or flex time off, we empower you with the options to work in the way that best serves your clients and your life. Consistent with the firm’s hybrid work model, this position will require in-person attendance at least three days per week, either at a GT office or client site. Here, you are supported to prioritize your overall well-being through work-life integration options that work best for you and those in your household. We understand that your needs, responsibilities and experiences are different — and we think that’s a good thing.
